text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Nakayama-san. I'm glad I ran into you. 
Happy birthday.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a lot. So, did you guys prepare a 
present for me too?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Know your place. How dare you beg from 
us?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, since we have the chance. A 
breathtaking, thrilling match— ...is what 
I'd like to say, but.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A lot of folks sent challenge letters as 
birthday presents, you see. I'm off to the 
first match right now—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... A match against the rabble, is it? 
You must be desperate to pass a boring 
day.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa there, calling them rabble when you 
don't even know who you're up against? 
Take them lightly and you're gonna get 
burned, you know."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That is quite intriguing. I would 
simply love to experience firsthand 
whatever this "hard lesson" is supposed to 
be.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Hah! That look in your eyes, it's 
making my skin prickle. But every single 
one is a serious match. I can't just drag 
you all along with me—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us have a match. Will you 
yield that honorable first race 
celebrating your birth to us... or not?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh. To pass the time, I shall 
personally be your opponent. —If you wish 
to proceed, emerge as the victor."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Won't go down easy, huh? Interesting, 
I'll take that bet! Let's taste the 
ultimate thrill—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait. Either way, this'll end up being 
our first match, won't it?"
